_readme: The mods GML Manager offers in its Browse tab. To list your mod, open a pull request adding an entry. Each mod needs a public GitHub repo whose releases carry a zip laid out like Binaries\Win64 (GML\plugins\<Name>\...). guid must match the GML_PLUGIN guid in the DLL; asset is a wildcard for the release zip's name. A zip over 2 GB can be split into parts (Name.zip.001, .002): list them with parts (a wildcard), give the joined zip's sha256, and point asset at nothing so managers before 2.4.4 fail cleanly. requires names another entry's guid, offered first.

mods.name: Noveske Chainsaw
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Adds a Noveske Chainsaw rifle to the gun spawner, with its own mesh, moving parts and PMAG. Nothing in the game is replaced.
mods.credits: Model and textures by 3DMA - 3D Military Assets, used under license

mods.name: Malfunctions
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Every gun jams as often as its real counterpart: duds, failures to feed, stovepipes and double feeds, each cleared by hand. The P320 is not drop safe.

mods.name: MP7 40-Round Magazine
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Every MP7 magazine holds 40 rounds and looks like the 40-rounder.
mods.credits: Magazine model by Alpooo (CGTrader, Royalty Free License)

mods.name: FPV Drone
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: An FPV kamikaze drone flown through DJI Goggles 2: acro flight model, Betaflight-style OSD and a grenade payload. Goggles in the Night Vision gear, drone in the explosives pouches; hold the right stick in to fly.
mods.credits: Models and textures by 3DMA - 3D Military Assets, used under license

mods.name: Saiga-12K
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: A full-auto Saiga-12K firing 12 gauge slugs, with the 5-round Sb.5 magazine and its own moving parts, in the gun station's Shotguns category.
mods.credits: Model and textures from Escape from Tarkov by Battlestate Games, redistributed with permission

mods.name: UAR-15
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: A UAR-15 in the Assault Rifles list: 20-inch AR-15 with a free-float M-LOK handguard, MBUS sights and its own moving parts, built on the game's M4A1.
mods.credits: Model and textures from the BONELAB Cold Weapon Pack by Bonewar, redistributed with permission

mods.name: Gunsmith
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Every attachment in the gun station changes how the gun handles: weight and balance, recoil, suppressor loudness, muzzle velocity, accuracy and scope glint.

mods.name: ECOTI Thermal Fusion
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: GPNVG-18 and PVS-31 with an ECOTI thermal clip-on in every phosphor, and a panoramic fusion goggle with an ATAK-style HUD: compass, team markers, waypoints.

mods.name: Custom Camo
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: One more camo, Custom Camo, at the end of the colour menu of every kit item that takes camo.

mods.name: Custom Patches
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Three new patches at the end of the kit station's patch menu: LarpTac, Rogue and Stripes, on helmets, caps and plate carriers.

mods.name: Hand Poser
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Make your own magazine hand poses: a web page (127.0.0.1:8765) sets where the hand sits and how every finger bends, live, while you hold the magazine.

mods.name: PvP
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Blue vs Red team deathmatch on the game's own missions: every mission gets a PvP mode with no AI, respawns at your base, rounds and grenades hurt players, and a wrist scoreboard. Only the host needs it.

mods.name: Custom Maps
mods.author: RemArrow
mods.description: Puts custom maps in the mission menu with a Free Roam mode. Maps are separate downloads: Myrne is in this list.

mods.name: Myrne (map)
mods.author: SpectrumB, ported by RemArrow
mods.description: Myrne, the snowy 660 m BONELAB village, rebuilt for Geronimo: pick it in the mission menu (Free Roam, or PvP with the PvP plugin). A 1.5 GB download; installs Custom Maps too if you don't have it.
mods.credits: Map by SpectrumB, shared with permission
